cards.name: Cousin
cards.text: Hand-me-down.

cards.name: Needle Page
cards.text: Pile on {pile_on}.

cards.name: Hedgerow Scout
cards.text: Hand-me-down.

cards.name: Harvest Piper
cards.text: Recruit: Give your other Mice +{attack} Attack.

cards.name: Hayloft Aunt
cards.text:
Hand-me-down.
Recruit: Add a Cousin to your hand.
cards.golden_text:
Hand-me-down.
Recruit: Add {count} Cousins to your hand.
reminders: Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Shrew Cutpurse
cards.text:
Pile on {pile_on}.
After this piles on, gain {gold} gold.

cards.name: Thimble Captain
cards.text: Charge {limit}: Whenever a neighbour attacks, summon a Cousin.
cards.golden_text: Charge 4: Whenever a neighbour attacks, summon a Cousin.
reminders: Charge: All uses come back at the start of each fight.
Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Fencing Master
cards.text:
Pile on {pile_on}.
After this piles on, it gains +{attack} Attack permanently.

cards.name: Bell-ringer
cards.text:
Hand-me-down.
Your Hand-me-downs give +{attack} more Attack.

cards.name: Needle Sister
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After this gains a Hand-me-down, it attacks immediately.
cards.golden_text: Charge 4: After this gains a Hand-me-down, it attacks immediately.
reminders: Charge: All uses come back at the start of each fight.
Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Dormouse Cook
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give your other Mice +{attack} Attack.

cards.name: Grandmother Hob
cards.text: Charge {limit}: After one of your Mice gains a Hand-me-down, give it +{attack} Attack permanently.
reminders: Charge: All uses come back at the start of each fight.
Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Thimble Sentinel
cards.text:
Guard.
Hand-me-down.

cards.name: Drill-sergeant
cards.text: Your Mice neighbouring this have Pile on {grant}.
reminders: Pile on N: The first N times a neighbour attacks each fight, this hits the target first.

cards.name: Parish Standard-bearer
cards.text: Start of fight: Give your Mice +{attack} Attack this fight for each Mouse you have.

cards.name: Widow Thimble
cards.text: Your Hand-me-downs go to the {heirs} nearest Mice.
reminders: Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Dame Bodkin
cards.text:
Pile on {pile_on}.
Your Mice's pile-on hits deal double damage.
cards.golden_text:
Pile on {pile_on}.
Your Mice's pile-on hits deal triple damage.

cards.name: Needle Pikeman
cards.text:
Pile on {pile_on}.
Can't attack.
After this piles on, your Mice with Pile on gain +{attack} Attack permanently.

cards.name: King Speck
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, fill your empty slots with Cousins.
cards.golden_text: Whenever this attacks, fill your empty slots with golden Cousins (4/4).
reminders: Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.

cards.name: Old Mother Needle
cards.text: Charge {limit}: Your Hand-me-downs are permanent.
reminders: Charge: All uses come back at the start of each fight.
Hand-me-down: When this dies, the nearest friendly Mouse gains its Attack this fight.
